realRepository.name: Sift
realRepository.selection: The same 1,530 tracked JavaScript, TypeScript and JSON paths as the retained Sift corpus, reconstructed from clean Git bytes.

async.assessment: Existing source review classifies three removals as corrected false positives, two as unknown wrappers, six as missed contextual review candidates, and both additions as review candidates.

convex.assessment: Existing per-location source review classifies all removals as corrected pattern scope and all additions as review candidates.

deepgram.assessment: New doctor; no definite Deepgram finding was established on this target.

effectV4Kitlangton.assessment: Exact rule, file and line parity.

openrouter.assessment: The documented migration removes the false SSE warning and declaration/catalog lookalikes; six actual pins move to request-selection locations and nine request-lifetime review candidates are added.

slop.assessment: Existing source review classifies 56 removals as intentional narrowing and 76 as corrected false positives. All 26 additions are explicitly worded source-review candidates, not deletion authorization.

limitations: Finding counts are not accuracy estimates; the retained per-location source classifications remain authoritative.
The candidate evaluates 671 eligible files versus 679 under 0.1.2; unsupported extension and analysis boundaries remain documented.
Async intentionally retains six missed contextual review candidates and two unknown wrappers rather than broadening the supported semantic contract.
The historical Sift manifest included one unrecoverable dirty generated declaration. This release uses the reproducible clean bytes of the pinned commit and records a new manifest digest.
npm authentication and publication are deliberately left to the package owner.
